item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-08-12
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天 Nervos Talk 上最热闹的讨论集中在 CCC 2.0.0 预发布帖里——话题从技术发布转向了 AI 与开发者未来的争论 [S02, S03, S04]。与此同时，CKB 生态双周更新 #22 发布，总结了近两周的开发进展 [S05]；CKBA 治理话题也有了官方回应，确认了当前贡献成员数量 [S13]。整体来看，论坛有多个话题在同步推进，并非平静的一天 [S02, S05, S13]。 ## 重点话题 **CCC 2.0.0 预发布帖内爆发关于 AI 取代开发者的争论**：Hanssen 直言 AI 已聪明到几乎不需要修改其代码，未来人类努力可能只是沦为 AI 的训练数据 [S02]。knmo 则用「12 岁孩子会煮意大利面」的比喻反讽 AI 能力尚不成熟 [S04]，AryaStark 建议应从用户需求出发，让 AI 真正成为解决问题的工具 [S01]。 **CKB 生态双周更新 #22 发布**：更新总结了近两周的基础设施与工具进展，包括 CKBdev 修复了 Tentacle、light client 等组件的安全问题 [S05]。knmo 补充了矿工版本分布数据，显示 0.209.0 版本占比已升至 89.51% [S06]。 **CKBA 治理问题持续被追问，官方开始给出具体信息**：AryaStark 希望获得可靠公开信息以评估 CKBA 治理状况 [S08]。matt_ckb 透露 Kevin 已离开项目去开发 Khalani，Daniel 也有一段时间未参与 [S09]。随后官方账号 CKBAMembership...

item.title: CCC 2.0.0 Prerelease - CoBuild, Coin 和 CKBC(oin) (4 posts)
item.description: Perhaps the approach should be to start with user needs and focus on solving problems; that way, AI can truly serve as a helpful tool. In any case, thank you very much for your contributions to the entire nervos network. 老实说，最新的 AI 模型们已经聪明到了一种程度，以至于很多时候我不需要对它产出的代码进行修改。我毫不怀疑，AI 会随着技术发展变得比现在更聪明，写出简洁、严谨、超越大多数程序员「正确」程度的代码。在那个时候（也许已经不远了），我很难再用「AI 需要被监视」来说服自己，这更多像是当下安慰自己的方式。 这也是为什么我会提出「迟早要被取代的家伙还在苟延残喘什么」，「再努力的人也只能沦为 AI 的训练数据」。人们在带着 12 岁的孩子往前走，而这个 12 岁的孩子正在积极地把人变成养料，让自己长大。 在这篇文章里，比起反对 AI，我更想作为有情感的人类，记录人与 AI 相处的尝试。（这一点我想感谢 @zz_tovarishch，和他的讨论总是让我受益匪浅） 其中一个方面是「人们能怎样使用 AI？」。我们既可以 Hanssen: 「阅读 CCC 里 UDT 相关的工具。请帮我制定一份重写相关逻辑的方案。」 放弃思考，把一切丢给 AI；也可以 Hanssen: 「忘了之前对话的内容吧。有趣的想法……你觉得怎么样？」 自己思考可能的做法，让 AI...

item.title: [RFC] 从 CellScript 包注册表到统一 CKB 产物注册表：身份、证据与消费边界 (1 posts)
item.description: I should probably clarify an boundary a bit,the current 0.23 Registry is not yet a universal trust generator. hash_bound now means that the bytes recorded by the Registry match the declared hashes. It does not prove that a file is safe, semantically correct, trustworthy in origin, or independently audited. The current on-chain commitment is not a global hash of the entire Registry either. It binds one specific namespace/name@release, its source, manifest and artifact hashes, and its already RPC-verified deployment evidence. item.title: Questions about CKBA (8 posts)
item.description: Thanks to Jan for clarifying that he is a Contributing Member of CKBA. I haven’t seen a response from CKBA or the other CKB founders, so I’m going to keep this simple and ask one concrete question at a time. As a CKB holder, I need reliable public information to assess governance continuity, key-person risk, and the long-term health of the project. The published operations roster tells us who is doing the day-to-day work, but it does not tell us who holds formal governance authority. Who currently serves on the CKBA Board? item.title: Spark Program | Fiber RGB++ Swap (1 posts)
item.description: Carl: without RGB++, there’s nothing to advertise or swap. It’s the foundation, not a side door. 你还是可以用 CKB 中的硬币，和从 RGB++ Leap 回来完全一样的那一种，来支撑 Swap 协议。这对这份协议并没有产生根本上的改变。 Carl: they simply don’t participate in advertisement relay, the same way they wouldn’t relay any message type they don’t know about. 我还是希望你能直接澄清问题：是否所有使用者都需要运行一个修改版本的 Fiber 节点？ 嘿，我不是来这里读 AI 生成的结果的，我有自己的 AI 工具。如果你愿意用自己的语言简要说明你想做什么事情，即使它看起来没那么 Fancy，我也会很感激你。

item.title: [DIS] fiber-payjoin-kit: Collaborative Privacy for the Nervos Fiber Network (1 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone, following all the feedback from this thread and the CKBuilder review, we have submitted a revised proposal with a reduced scope and budget. The Lightning equivalent (lightning-payjoin-kit) is now complete with a working two-node LDK harness. The new proposal is scoped to Phase 1 only, with two concrete end-to-end demos against a real Fiber node addressing the fee-contribution and funding privacy pain points highlighted. New proposal here: link Any support would go a lot during the 7-day vote window.

item.title: [DIS] fiber-payjoin-kit: Collaborative Channel Funding Privacy for the Nervos Fiber Network RES (1 posts)
item.description: [DIS] fiber-payjoin-kit: Collaborative Channel Funding Privacy for the Nervos Fiber Network RESub Executive Summary When a Fiber Network payment channel is opened, the funding transaction is permanently recorded on CKB Layer 1. Standard channel openings use a single funder, all CellInputs belong to one wallet. Chain surveillance tools use this to identify who opened the channel and cluster their complete transaction history. fiber-payjoin-kit is an open-source Rust library enabling collaborative channel funding on the Nervos Fiber Network. Both parties contribute CellInputs to the funding transaction, making chain attribution impossible. This proposal requests $6,000 for Phase 1: the core...

item.title: CKB Governance: cell-native DAO voting protocol on testnet (create poll question, vote, delegate, aggregate & close ) (1 posts)
item.description: Hey @anihdev, thank you for asking me directly and for putting this on testnet!! The shape makes sense to me. The governance lock consuming the intent while the refund lock stays in data cleanly separates who can aggregate from who gets the capacity back, and the lanes look like the right answer to one shared tally cell. anihdev: Finalization does not prove that every timely intent was aggregated.
